description: Figure 8 displays a line plot illustrating the results of shared Top-6 routed experts across two independent samples of a task. The x-axis represents the sample size, which is presented on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^17 (equivalent to 32 samples with a sequence length of 4096) to 2^19 (equivalent to 128 samples with a sequence length of 4096). The y-axis shows the shared Top-6 routed experts, averaged by model layers, and is presented on a linear scale ranging from approximately 0 to 1. The plot contains two distinct lines: one is a solid blue line with circular markers, and the other is a dashed red line with square markers. Both lines exhibit a nearly flat, horizontal trend across the entire range of the x-axis, indicating that the average number of shared Top-6 routed experts remains consistently high and stable as the sample size increases from 2^17 to 2^19. The values for both lines remain approximately constant at around 0.95 throughout the plotted range.
